name: 2d-action-rpg-production
description: Korean-first workflow guidance for sprite-based 2D action RPG and belt-scroll production. Scope and evaluation limits are explicit.

interface.longDescription: Workflow guidance for sprite-based 2D action RPGs and belt-scroll games, with Korean-first narrative, dialogue, motion timing, skill effects, party/inventory UI, research and handoff references. Adjacent 2D genres require adaptation. This is not a game engine, asset pack, autonomous game generator, 3D/VR pipeline or multiplayer integration. No MCP server, hooks, credentials or paid-generation tools are bundled. Initial behavioral evaluation covers a small set of text-only tasks; real runtime, visual and commercial outcomes are not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Review a 2D action RPG skill for weapon, hit and visual consistency.
Fix Korean dialogue continuity without inventing new canon.
Plan a focused party inventory UI review.
